blocks.text: Boundary Beach, Tsawwassen: Neighbourhood Guide
Living in Boundary Beach

parts.t: Boundary Beach is an MLS® area in Tsawwassen, close to Boundary Bay and the US border. Because it's near the bay, ask about flooding and how high a home has to be built.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 11, 2026. I have worked in Lower Mainland real estate for 11+ years. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Delta.
General information only, not legal, planning or financial advice. Before buying or selling at Boundary Beach, look at the zoning, then the community plan, then the schools serving the address.

blocks.text: Planning in Boundary Beach

parts.t: In 2024 Delta adopted a new Official Community Plan, and zoning along with the plan’s content can vary from lot to lot.

Delta’s small-scale multi-unit housing rules let a single detached or duplex lot hold up to 3 units when it is 280 square metres or less, and up to 4 on a larger lot. Any suites count toward that limit.
Some low-lying and waterfront lots can carry a title rule, called a covenant, about the height the living space must be built to. You can see minimum flood elevations on DeltaMap.
Dike changes need written approval from the Inspector of Dikes.

blocks.text: Before you buy in Boundary Beach

parts.t: Ask the City of Delta for the property’s zoning, along with what the plan says about it and its neighbours.
Use the Delta School District school locator for the exact address.
For a shorefront lot, ask whether there is an engineered seawall, who maintains it, and what Delta requires for changes.
Visit on a summer weekend to see beach and park traffic near Boundary Bay Regional Park.
Check the roof, drainage and major systems.
For flooding, Delta can tell you the required building height, and the title should be read for any covenants.

blocks.text: Boundary Beach questions

parts.t: Boundary Beach is an MLS® area name in Tsawwassen. The official community name for this area is
, just inside the BC-Washington border, east of Tsawwassen Beach.
Is there an official Boundary Beach boundary?

Boundary Beach is an MLS® sub-area name used by the real estate board rather than an official municipal boundary. The official BC community name for the area is Boundary Bay; ask me about any specific address.
Is Boundary Beach prone to flooding?
Delta issued a flood advisory for the Beach Grove and Boundary Bay communities in December 2022. Check the exact property for title rules (covenants) and how high a home must be built.
